items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I’ve got it covered. In fact I played behind Madonna’s brother I think, piano, recently on a gig, a trio.

ctx.x: I’ve got it covered. In fact I played behind Madonna’s brother I think, piano, recently on a gig, a trio.
No kidding. What does Madonna’s brother do?

items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I understand he says, “Oh that’s Madonna’s brother, Joey Ciccone.”

ctx.x: No, but is he a singer or something?
He sings, yeah. I don’t know if it’s professionally or what but he got a gig and I understand he says, “Oh that’s Madonna’s brother, Joey Ciccone.”
Oh yeah that last name rings a bell, that’s right.
